n1.text: In the sixth year of Zhongping, Dong Zhuo entered Luoyang and deposed the young emperor. You spent your fortune in Chenliu and raised three thousand men; your officers are waiting for you to speak. Grain, troops, coin and standing are all short.

strings.failure.0: The grain is gone and the army is slipping away.
strings.failure.1: The troops have scattered; you have no men left to command.
strings.failure.2: The lords have turned away; nobody answers your orders.
